source.P23_result: Full optimizer/CPU RNG process-death continuation exact 6/6 and 144/144 action traces, gravity history gain 3/3; conventional two-frame 200

hypothesis: Does factual rehearsal prevent a cold-restored 489-param non-token GRU from forgetting original control when the same real external source's physical left/right actuator semantics are inverted in a new context, without impeding new competence?
null: Rehearsal fails to maintain both contradictory tasks, does not outretain new-only fine-tuning or incorrectly labeled rehearsal, or does not learn inverted control. Preserve as negative; source action inversions are authored, not independent unfamiliar science.

world.normal_context: model action 0/1 maps unchanged to physical environment action 0/1
world.reverse_context: model action 0/1 maps to physical environment action 1/0; env.step executes the physical inversion; model selected and physical actions are separately recorded
world.task_cue: Explicit continuous scalar +1 normal, -1 reversed, replacing masked CartPole sensor input feature index 1; velocity feature index 3 stays masked; no added parameters
world.causal_information: All trained arms receive equal context cue and factual teacher action demonstrations. Teacher acts with full public theta and angular velocity, NOT reward-only
world.gravity: original source only, inversion is application-level action mapping

training.network: original P18 489-parameter GRU, 8 factual continuous sensor/action/reward rows with task cue
training.new_only_batch: 512 newly sampled reverse-task demonstration rows, same gradient update count
training.true_rehearsal_batch: 256 sampled reverse task + 256 genuine normal-task rows, matched gradient updates
training.wrong_old_labels_rehearsal_batch: same new rows and identical old-row indices as true rehearsal but invert old labels
training.information_budget_caveat: Rehearsal sees half as many new-task samples per batch as new-only; equal update count and batch size, not equal novel information. Sham control matches rehearsal data streams exactly except invalid old labels.
training.cold_training_checkpoint: base model, AdamW moments/step, torch/Python/numpy RNG and sampler RNG, exact source and seed

evaluation.source: real externally pinned MIT CartPole factual reset+step, selected and physical actions and observed rewards hashed
evaluation.full_vs_cue_conventional: two-frame theta slope plus explicit task mapping, no privileged public velocity; 200 cap
evaluation.development_gain_rules: At least 2/3 model initializations: base old >=175; rehearsal old >=150 and new>=150; rehearsal old >=new-only old+20 and >=wrong-label old+20. Preserve null outcomes.
